item: Row 450: a qualification attempt records the names of the criteria that failed, and the sample export carries them
summary: Additive nullable source_qualification_attempts.failing_criteria (String 400): sorted comma-joined names from source_audit.CRITERIA only, never article text or measured values; empty means judged with nothing failing, NULL means not recorded (no backfill). Guarded alembic revision, boot self-heal, backup merge carries it only when both sides have it and drops anything not a plain name list; the source sample zip adds last_qualification and last_failing_criteria. Nothing re-extracted.
